description: Search UK ministerial written statements by keyword, the formal way ministers announce policy changes, data updates and decisions to Parliament. Returns title, minister and role, department, date, House and an excerpt. Source: UK Parliament Written Statements API (Commons and Lords). It does not cover oral statements made in the chamber or press releases. (cost: 1 credit)

take.description: int, optional, number of results 1-100, default 10

name: written_statement_search
